sam_capital_financial:7d76ff6eff13.method: Gap map K9: for each domestic capital account, K9 = row total - column total over every block's prior entries (saving: K1 here, fincorp K2a, government K3a, NAS 2026 St 1.9 household saving for K_HH because closure writes K4a later; capital transfers K6/R2k; D3; GFCF, CIS, valuables; every financial entry). Written on I_OTHR <- K_s as a pair so balancing can move the net across zero (XR-17): residual_pos = the sum of the positive and residual_neg = the sum of the negative pair terms (satellite k9_decomposition, items pair:*), which group the exact decomposition (items term:*: NAS vs FSF published net lending; FSF reconciliation by instrument; household and RoW replacements; FSF items never read) as nas_vs_fsf, row_counterparty (all RoW instruments in one term), fsf_unwritten, and per instrument the household and domestic layers combined (hh_dom:<instrument>; an FSF cell published without a counterparty, such as insurers' F6, is mostly households' and would otherwise appear as two opposite terms). The grouping sets the gross size of the pair and so how cheaply balancing (free, low; cost scales with the prior) can move K9: a weight choice. A finding, not a target. K9_HH carries the capital transfers to households NAS household saving cannot see (DECISIONS D2-6).

sam_capital_financial:8c817b11d16a.method: Gap map I1a: GFCF by commodity x investing account. Rows: SUT 2023-24 GFCF by product (use.gfcf.sut_pNNN) summed to commodities with the committed concordance io_tables_sut_product_to_sam34. Columns: NAS 2026 St 1.11 GFCF by sector x (SUT total / NAS total). GG split Centre/States by a capital-spending key (Union capital outlay less departmental commercial and investment heads 5002, 5003, 5201, 5225, 5275, 4416, 5465-5467, plus IGAS-2 capital grants to central autonomous bodies and to statutory bodies and development authorities, which government's K6 treats as inside G_CEN (its A-K6-4); vs RBI State Finances total capital outlay plus IGAS-2 capital grants to urban local bodies): the institutional view (DECISIONS D2-8) as far as clean data allow. FC: K_RBI = RBI Annual Report change in net fixed assets + depreciation (public); the rest of public FC and all private FC over K_BANK/K_NBFC/K_INSP by fincorp's F4a GOS by ownership part (CFC is not published; XR-6 boundary). Prior p(c,k) = column total x NAS 1.11 asset share of the column's sector x SUT(c)/SUT(asset group of c) (asset groups in params.ASSET_OF); RAS to rows and columns to 1e-09 relative (13 iterations). The NAS asset classes are not constraints: NAS structures differ from SUT construction by Rs 82,666 crore.

sam_closure:a0015acd9542.method: Gap map D1: the published household residual (NAS 2026 derived series: St 1.14 household GDI - FCE - gross saving) as the target of the written D1 total, with a +-Rs 1 crore band (DECISIONS D2-3).

sam_closure:f2bb2f00c921.method: Gap map D1 allocation (ESTIMATED): the D1 total (D2 + D3 + D4 as written) split over the 10 household groups in proportion to each group's prior gross income (the sum of all entries with row = H_g, i.e. factor income, property income and current transfers received), rounded to 6 decimals with the remainder on the group with the largest income. Pinned (fixed): X_DISC is never balanced. Neutral between 'income overstated' and 'consumption or saving understated' (plan s.5 C6); PFCE and population splits are published in hh_saving as a sensitivity.

sam_factors:092d48229017.method: Gap map V2a household anchor: NAS 2026 Statement 7.1C household-sector OS/MI + CFC of the NAS industry group (rows listed in the constraint description) = the household components (mixed income, hh_quasi, household dwellings) of the group's activities (XR-20).

sam_factors:21f431329f5b.method: Gap map V2a(a): household dwelling surplus = 7.1C real-estate/professional gross OS/MI minus the household non-dwelling part (ASUSE ratio method), capped at A_DWEL GOS; all of it to F_GOSC. Imputed part = min(s_imp x A_DWEL GOS, household dwelling surplus), with s_imp = households' C4a imputed rent / (imputed + actual rent + government housing); actual (rented-out) part = the rest. The CFC-based alternative is rejected (issues factors-1: 7.1C group-9 CFC is below SUT dwelling CFC); the rest of A_DWEL GOS is corporate/government-owned dwellings (corp_gov).

sam_factors:2cda5e3446b9.method: Gap map F1: labour income of households = NAS 2026 CE receivable by residents (Statement 7.1 CE + 6.1 CE from RoW - 6.1 CE to RoW); the F1a entries must sum to it.

sam_factors:4074edb2d1cb.method: Gap map F4: sector GOS = GVA - CE - net production taxes, NAS 2026. Public NFC = Statement 7.1A total - 8.15.1 total (general government) - 7.1A financial row; private NFC = 7.1B total - 7.1B financial row; public FC = 7.1A financial; private FC = 7.1B financial; GG = 8.15.1 total (GOS = CFC); households incl. NPISH = 7.1C total (OS/MI). E_NFPU and E_NFPR entries are the NFC GOS; FC and GG are constraints (fincorp writes F4a, F4b splits GG).

sam_factors:4c44ce99c919.method: Gap map V2a, multi-activity NAS groups (manufacturing, other services), where the gap map's 'SUT OS shares within the group' are pro rata to GVA (Q2): the group's 7.1C household gross OS/MI is spread over its activities by a two-column RAS (rows = SUT GOS by activity; columns = household total and the rest); household prior = ASUSE 2023-24 surplus of unincorporated enterprises of the mapped categories (Table 4 establishments x Table 37 GVA per establishment, OAE + HWE, minus Table 33 hired workers x emoluments per hired worker); rest prior = the activity's GOS. Mapping: M2 food; M3+M4 beverages & tobacco; M1+M5+M6+M7 textiles; M8+M9+M10+M23 wood/paper/furniture; M24 gems & other; M11 petroleum; M12+M14 chemicals; M13 pharma; M15 non-metallic; M16 metals; M17+M20+M25 machinery; M18+M19 electrical; M21+M22 transport equipment; S13 education; S14 health; S15 other services. Mining: all 7.1C household mining is quarrying (A_OMIN); coal and oil/gas have no household part (assumption). Group 9: household non-dwelling surplus = 7.1C real-estate/professional CE x ASUSE (GVA - emoluments)/emoluments of S7+S10+S11+S12 (ownership of dwellings has no CE), split between A_ITSV (S7) and A_BSRE (S10-S12) by ASUSE surplus; the rest of group 9 is dwellings (see the dwelling record). ASUSE levels are used only as shares or ratios.

sam_factors:52e21c933d57.method: Gap map F3 (constraint only): household-sector gross OS/MI = NAS 2026 Statement 7.1C total OS/MI + CFC; F2 (mixed income) + F3a + F3b + F3c must sum to it, so F_GOSC clears.

sam_factors:57704eca7f9a.method: Gap map V2a household cap (XR-20, kind max): the household components of an activity's surplus are at most its SUT 2023-24 OS/MI + CFC (production's V2 target, with production's tolerance). Declared for the activities of multi-activity NAS groups only: in a single-activity group the 7.1C control fixes the household part exactly, and financial services / public administration have none.

sam_factors:62a806299af4.method: Gap map V1a, fallback without PLFS unit data (D1-2). CE by activity = production's V1 targets (SUT 2023-24). For each PLFS Table 20 industry group g (01-03, 05-09, 10-33, 35-39, 41-43, 45-47, 49-53, 55-56, 58-99) and area s: workers = WPR_s (PLFS ps+ss, all ages) x persons_s (households' pop_persons, summed by area) x sum of Table 26 worker shares of the NIC sections in g; regular bill = workers x Table 20 regular-wage share x 12 x mean of API indicator 6 regular monthly earnings of area s over Q1-Q4 2023-24; casual bill = workers x Table 20 casual share x Table 51 casual daily wage of g (section wages weighted by Table 26 shares; a missing area cell uses the section's all-area wage) x D days (306.80, record sam_factors:2da87d66d006). share_reg_g = sum_s regular / sum_s (regular + casual); F_LREG = share_reg_g x CE of each activity in g (every activity of a group gets the group share: the SUT's CE is pro rata within MoSPI groups, so nothing finer exists); F_LCAS = CE - F_LREG. Floor: regular CE by NAS group >= 7.1A public-sector CE (none binds unless logged). Assumptions: usual-status worker shares and CWS earnings combine; wage bills are used only as shares, never as levels. CE includes employers' actual and imputed social contributions (e.g. departmental enterprises' pension liabilities, paid to households by the public non-financial corporations E_NFPU under R9d, D2-9; government's imputed OPS contributions, paid back to households by government under R9b).

sam_factors:6316094158f4.method: Gap map F3b: actual rent received by household landlords (V2a hh_dwelling_actual total) keyed by owners of property, not tenants: households' AIDIS 2019 fixed-assets key by group (aidis_fixed_assets; stocks at 2018-06-30). Proxy: AIDIS tables on rented-out residential property are not located (labour_enterprise_surveys-2, -19). Low confidence.

sam_factors:6b22f2494831.method: Gap map F2 (fallback without unit data). Totals: farm = V2a mixed income of A_CROP, A_LVST, A_FOFI; non-farm = the rest. Rural/urban: farm by PLFS farm self-employment earnings (workers of group 01-03 by area from V1a x Table 20 self-employed share x mean API indicator 8 self-employment earnings, Q1-Q4 2023-24; the gap map's 100% rural is the sensitivity); non-farm by ASUSE 2023-24 surplus (GVA - emoluments) of the activity's categories by area (establishment location proxies the household's area; the categories of the V2a(b) record, e.g. T1-T5 for trade); mining, construction and utilities by PLFS groups 05-09, 41-43 and 35-39 self-employment earnings (workers x Table 20 self-employed share x API indicator 8, as for farm; ASUSE has no category for household utilities: E is only non-captive electricity and NIC 36-39 sits inside S15). Within an area: persons x IFPRI 2022/23 per-capita index (farm: crop land + agricultural capital; non-farm: non-agricultural capital; T10 x T11), mapped with k = q: the k-th group of each area takes the k-th national quintile's index (DECISIONS D2-19; the crosswalk and an HCES-rescaled variant are sensitivity rows in factor_income_keys). Low confidence.

sam_factors:748f19676832.method: Gap map V3: NAS 2026 Statement 6.1 item 2, compensation of employees from the rest of the world, as published; all of it to regular labour (F_LREG): gap-map assumption (seafarers, mission staff are salaried).

sam_factors:7edffe6473b8.method: Gap map V1a floor (plan s.2.1 step 6): regular CE of a NAS industry group >= that group's public-sector CE, NAS 2026 Statement 7.1A 'Compensation of employees' (sum of the 7.1A rows listed in the constraint description). Not applied to agriculture and construction, where government departments may employ muster-roll (casual) labour; NAS groups 9 and 11 are compared together because the SUT keeps R&D in A_EDUC while NAS files it under group 9.

sam_factors:83f7e0f98d7b.method: Gap map V1a for A_PADM: all SUT CE of public administration and defence is regular wages (F_LREG); assumption: NAS GG CE includes the imputed OPS pension contributions, which accrue to regular employees only, and muster-roll labour in government is booked in construction/agriculture.

sam_factors:86900a845b24.method: Gap map F4, general government: GG GOS = GG CFC (OS = 0), NAS 2026 Statement 8.15.1 total CFC; split between Centre and States by F4b.

tables: Finance Accounts 2023-24, Appendix to Statement No. 9 (IGAS-2)

sam_factors:94887701c5e4.method: Constraint f4b.centre (audit BS-12, factors-23): the Centre's F4b entry (G_CEN <- F_GOSC) within a band around its NAS 4.1 NVA-key value. Tolerance = max(5%, |key share - sensitivity A share| / key share) = 5.00%. The 5% is a judgement band with no source: no clean source splits GG CFC between the Centre and the States (NAS 4.1 publishes CFC for GG only; factors-15), and the gap to sensitivity A (1.04%) is only a floor, so the band is not derived from sensitivity A. If the band binds in balancing, its edge, not evidence, sets the balanced G_CEN (it bound at its upper edge in the wave C run of 2026-10-01). Owner item for Checkpoint B (factors-23).

sam_factors:96435e5135b2.method: Gap map F3c: surplus of household partnerships, trusts and co-operatives (V2a hh_quasi) by group. Rural/urban by ASUSE 2023-24 non-proprietary GVA of each activity's categories by area (the categories of the V2a(b) record, e.g. T1-T5 for trade); within an area by persons x the IFPRI 2022/23 non-agricultural capital index (T10 x T11), mapped with k = q: the k-th group of each area takes the k-th national quintile's index (DECISIONS D2-19; the crosswalk and an HCES-rescaled variant are sensitivity rows in factor_income_keys). Low confidence.

sam_factors:abbff6e7f6ee.method: Gap map V2a(b): surplus of household-sector partnerships between different households, societies/trusts, co-operatives and 'others' goes to F_GOSC (component hh_quasi), not mixed income. Share q_a = sum over OAE and HWE of ASUSE 2023-24 Table 6 establishment shares of those ownership types x the type's GVA (Table 4 x Table 37), divided by all GVA of the activity's ASUSE categories; hh_quasi = q_a x the household part of the activity, and mixed income (F_MIXD) = the household part - hh_quasi (the household part is exact at NAS-group level in single-activity groups: 7.1C). Proprietary units, same-household partnerships and SHGs stay mixed income. Assumption: non-proprietary units have their type's average GVA per establishment. Categories: ASUSE sub-categories for every activity, as in the V2a RAS record for manufacturing and other services, and T1+T2+T3+T4+T5 trade (not the aggregate T), S1+S2 hotels, S3-S6 transport, S7 communication and IT, S10-S12 business services. q = 0 (logged) for farming, mining and construction (outside ASUSE) and for utilities (ASUSE category E is only non-captive electricity, NIC 35103/35105-35107/35109, and NIC 36-39 sits inside S15 with personal services, so no ASUSE category describes household utilities).

tables: Finance Accounts 2023-24, Appendix to Statement No. 9 (IGAS-2)

sam_factors:b68d202efe5e.method: Gap map F4b: GG GOS (= CFC, NAS 8.15.1) split pro rata to NAS 2026 Statement 4.1 NVA, institutional view (D2-8). Centre = central government NVA + central autonomous bodies, proxied by Union revenue grants-in-aid to autonomous bodies (Finance Accounts 2023-24 IGAS-2: cash grants total minus grants for creation of capital assets), capped at the 4.1 autonomous-institutions NVA; States = State governments + local bodies + the rest of the autonomous institutions (the States' grants to their autonomous bodies are not in clean data). Assumption: equal CFC/NVA ratios across governments.

sam_factors:b79362f116d1.method: Gap map F3a: household imputed-rent operating surplus (V2a hh_dwelling_imputed total) keyed exactly like households' C4a imputed-rent consumption by group (each group's share of the C4a imputed_rent entries), so each group's imputed-rent income is proportional to its imputed-rent consumption; the levels differ (output vs surplus).

sam_factors:c2487f0f6b07.method: Gap map F1a, fallback without PLFS unit data (D1-2). Factor totals: F_LREG = V1a regular CE + V3 - V4; F_LCAS = V1a casual CE. Rural/urban: each PLFS group's regular (casual) CE split by its rural and urban regular (casual) wage bills from V1a (PLFS Tables 20/26/51, API 6); A_PADM (all regular) is in PLFS group 58-99 (NIC section O), so its regular CE is split by that group's regular wage bills; V3 - V4 pro rata to the regular rural/urban split. Within an area, group g gets persons_g (households' pop_persons) x I_g, normalised; I_q = IFPRI 2022/23 T10 share of the factor in quintile q's income x T11 total spending per capita, normalised (regular: medium + high-educated labour; casual: low-educated labour), mapped with k = q: the k-th group of each area takes the k-th national quintile's index (DECISIONS D2-19; the crosswalk and an HCES-rescaled variant are sensitivity rows in factor_income_keys). IFPRI is old base, 2022-23, national quintiles: used only as gradients (low confidence).

sam_factors:d4dd8f015971.method: Gap map V2a, single-activity NAS groups (crops, livestock, forestry+fishing, utilities, construction, trade & repair, hotels, transport, communication) and the groups with no household sector (financial: 7.1C = 0; public administration: GG only): household gross OS/MI of the group = NAS 2026 Statement 7.1C OS/MI + CFC of its rows (transport = railways + road + water + transport services + storage; 7.1C has no air row); corp_gov = SUT GOS of the activity (production's V2 target) - household part. Mixed income = the household part where the partnership/trust share q is 0 (no ASUSE category describes the activity's household part: crops, livestock, forestry+fishing, utilities, construction; see the V2a(b) record).

sam_factors:e71f59473f4f.method: Gap map V4: NAS 2026 Statement 6.1 item 7, compensation of employees to the rest of the world, as published; paid out of regular labour income (F_LREG), gap-map assumption.

sam_factors:f81d5cd9beca.method: Gap map F4, financial corporations: FC GOS = NAS 2026 Statement 7.1A financial OS + CFC + 7.1B financial OS + CFC (added in that order; the same series and arithmetic as fincorp's F4a total). factors writes no FC entry: fincorp's F4a entries must sum to it.

sam_fincorp:10110fd1063b.method: Gap map R3a (plan s.2.4): each payer line x HBS T107 holder shares (average of end-March 2023 and 2024): dated securities = MH 2049.01.101 less accrued interest and premium received on re-issues (Receipt MH 0049.03.116/.117); T-bills = 01.103+.108+.110; SDLs = RBI SF App. II market loans. FPI parts are rest_of_world's R14 (read, XR-12) and RBI's part is the RBI AR figure; the remainder is spread over the other holders: banks (commercial, co-operative) E_BANK; primary dealers and FIs E_NBFC; insurance, provident and pension funds E_INSP; mutual funds looked through to unit holders (SEBI T72: banks E_BANK, corporates E_NFPR); corporates E_NFPU/E_NFPR and 'others' (less State governments) by FSF counterparty holdings of government securities. Other Union securities (conversion, green, other internal debt, deposits, petroleum and fertiliser bonds) use the dated-security holder shares (low). States' other internal debt (App. II ii less market loans and NSSF, less States' WMA/overdraft interest to RBI) to E_BANK/E_NBFC by FSF State loan liabilities to ODCs / OFCs; States' WMA/overdraft interest = RBI AR loans-and-advances interest less the Centre's WMA, by FSF RBI loan assets. Households' parts are R8a; GPF/State PF interest is R9c.

sam_fincorp:19c2349607ce.method: Gap map R8 (plan s.2.6; RBI corporate finances not available): issuer totals: E_NFPU = dividends government books from it (government block R7, Centre + States) / the Centre's + States' share of its equity; E_BANK = the Union's R7 bank dividends / the Centre's share of ODC equity (FSF F51, average end-March 2023/2024; only the Union's bank dividends are in R7); E_INSP = IRDAI 2023-24 interim + proposed final dividends (life, non-life); E_NFPR and E_NBFC (private) = public NFCs' dividends / GOS ratio (assumption record) x their GOS (factors F4; F4a). Holders: the government parts are government's R7 entries (not written here); the issuer total less R7 goes to the non-government holders by their FSF F51 equity shares (government holders excluded: the private E_NBFC total has no government holder, E_INSP's total is net of the LIC dividend the Centre books); OFC holdings split into NBFCs / insurers and PFs / mutual funds by the sub-sectors' F51 assets; mutual funds looked through to unit holders (SEBI T72). The RoW part is a memo (rest_of_world writes R14 on its own basis); households' part is R8a. Intra-account holdings (E_NFPR <- E_NFPR) are kept (FRAMEWORK_REQUESTS P-5).

sam_fincorp:1e86aa1ea7f3.method: Gap map R3a, E_RBI: RBI Annual Report 2023-24 (vintage 2024-05-30) interest on rupee securities (Sch. 13 A) plus amortisation of premium/discount (Sch. 14 A), accrual, split Centre/States by HBS T107 RBI holding shares x the payer lines; the Centre's WMA interest (MH 2049.01.115).

sam_fincorp:262ea2c92423.method: Gap map R8a, small savings (savings deposits, certificates and PPF; D41 paid by the NSSF inside G_CEN): NSSF interest income = Union interest to the NSSF (MH 2049.01.121/.122/.125) + States' interest on NSSF loans (RBI SF App. II), passed to small savers (the NSSF ran close to balance: accumulated deficit 8,772.61 at end-March 2024); groups by hh_keys aidis_small_savings.

sam_fincorp:2affd44f4de7.method: Gap map R4 (plan s.2.5): interest paid by E_BANK (FSF ODC incl. co-op banks and deposit-taking NBFCs/HFCs, XR-6) and E_NBFC on deposits, borrowings and bonds, by creditor: FSF 2023-24 who-to-whom stocks (average end-March 2023/2024) x RTP 2023-24 SCB cost of deposits / cost of borrowings, scaled to each lender's RTP P&L interest expended (SCBs, RRBs, UCBs, StCBs, DCCBs; NBFC-UL/ML interest financial expenditure (the narrower interest-payment line is too small for their FSF debt), HFC financial expenditure, AIFIs, SPDs; deposit-taking NBFC/HFC share by FSF loans) less interest to RBI (RBI AR), to RoW (rest_of_world R14 NRI-deposit and other-investment interest) and, for E_NBFC, to E_BANK (computed on E_BANK's side). OFC counterparties are split into NBFCs, insurers/PFs and mutual funds by the sub-sectors' FSF positions; mutual funds are looked through to unit holders (SEBI T72). Creditors include the Centre and the States (G_CEN, G_STA): their FSF deposits with ODCs, and their holdings of bank and NBFC/AIFI bonds and loans to banks and NBFCs (government's R7x books only fiscal cash lines from non-financial payers, government-29), all low confidence. SNA basis: deposit interest of NFCs includes FISIM on deposits (reference-rate split of NAS 1.13 IC FISIM, r* recorded); no FISIM on government or inter-FC positions (NAS 1.13).

sam_fincorp:4186b8f721e3.method: Constraint target for R9c GPF: Union Finance Accounts 2023-24 MH 2049.03.104 interest credited to GPF, as published.

sam_fincorp:44ad8c3f4158.method: Gap map R3a, instruments with a known holder: recapitalisation bonds (MH 2049.01.132/.133) and SBI special bonds (60.110) to E_BANK.

sam_fincorp:4a7d472c7b03.method: Gap map R8a: household property income by group. Totals: government securities held directly (T107 'others' household part by FSF, sovereign gold bonds, gold monetisation; R3a), mutual-fund look-through of government, bank, NBFC, NFC interest and of dividends (SEBI T72 HNIs + retail), bank and NBFC deposit interest on the SNA basis (bank interest + FISIM on deposits: the households block's C4b fisim_deposits by group, grossed up for household producers' IC FISIM), NBFC/bank bonds held by households (R4 method) and dividends (R8 method). Keys: hh_keys aidis_deposits (deposits), aidis_equity (dividends), aidis_mf (MF), aidis_fin_assets (securities); AIDIS 2019 structure (low).

sam_fincorp:5ad606278166.method: Gap map R9c: Union interest credited to GPF (Finance Accounts 2023-24 MH 2049.03.104 'interest on State Provident Funds', i.e. the Union's GPF, official) split over household groups by factors' estimated public-sector wage key; the groups are estimates (free, medium) and the published total is held by the constraint r9c.gpf_union (verifier V-FIN-2).

sam_fincorp:60e80d38dab3.method: Gap map K2a, E_RBI: RBI's saving = the balance of E_RBI's current account over the SAM entries: GOS (F4a), interest received from government, banks and NBFCs (R3a, R4; RBI AR accrual), reserve income from RoW (rest_of_world R13, RBI AR component only: the unexplained BoP excess is left to balancing, D2-7), less interest paid (R4, R14) and the surplus paid to the Centre on the cash basis (government R6, D0-7/D2-16). Holding gains and provisions are not income.

sam_fincorp:61f4c191979c.method: Gap map K2a (plan s.2.11; no dividend or tax data by FC sub-sector): each sub-sector's public and private saving = its F4a GOS part x (NAS 2026 St 1.9 public FC saving less E_RBI's, over public GOS excluding RBI) or x (private FC saving / private FC GOS). Reproduces the NAS public and private totals; low confidence (balancing makes K2a the residual of each FC account).

sam_fincorp:62cffb04e3bc.method: Constraint target for R5 E_INSP <- E_NFPR nongov_bonds (audit BS-1, fincorp-32): RBI FSF ICPF holdings of the payer's bonds (average of end-March 2023 and 2024) x the corporate coupon (RBI RTP 2023-24 SCB cost of borrowings), unscaled (fincorp-30); band 25%, the spread of corporate bond coupons around it.

sam_fincorp:674ae827e2c5.method: Constraint target for R17: IRDAI 2023-24 net incurred claims, all direct general and health insurers (T44 total), as published; D71 = D72 (expected-claims approach).

sam_fincorp:6ae55e945b3f.method: Constraint targets for K2: NAS 2026 St 1.9 gross saving of financial corporations, total, public and private, as published.

sam_fincorp:6e5836096630.method: Constraint target for R8 E_NFPR <- E_NFPU interest_mf_lookthrough (audit BS-1, fincorp-32): RBI FSF MF holdings of public NFC bonds x the corporate coupon (fincorp-30), looked through to private NFC unit holders by SEBI T72; band 25%, the spread of corporate bond coupons around it.

sam_fincorp:7e7130491097.method: Gap map R5 (plan s.2.5): interest received by E_BANK and E_NBFC on loans and non-government bonds from NFCs and household groups: FSF stocks x RTP SCB return on advances / return on investments, scaled to each lender's RTP P&L interest income less government-securities interest (R3a), RBI (RBI AR), RoW (rest_of_world R13 other-investment income) and, for E_NBFC, interest from E_BANK. E_INSP (policy and other loans, corporate bonds; FSF ICPF stocks x the same rates, unscaled). SNA basis: less FISIM on loans (NFCs: NAS 1.13 IC FISIM by user sector (IC shares of 7.1A less NAS 8.15.1 GG IC in every industry 8.15.1 publishes (construction, other services, public administration, utilities) / 7.1B / 7.1C per industry) split deposits/loans by (r_L - r*)L and (r* - r_D)D; households: the households block's C4b `fisim_loans` by group, grossed up for household producers' IC FISIM). Household groups by hh_keys `aidis_inst_loans`.

sam_fincorp:8bdadadd0110.method: Constraint target for R8/R8a paid by E_NFPU to non-government holders (fincorp-32 (a), audit BS-1): the dividend matrix's public NFC issuer total (government R7 grossed up by FSF F51 holder shares) less R7 and E_NFPU's own holding, direct and looked through MF units (the households' MF component includes MF-held bond interest); band 25%.

sam_fincorp:908d589b1c4f.method: Constraint targets for R3b (plan s.2.3): Union = MH 2049 total less intra-G_CEN interest (NSSF special securities, reserve funds, FCI and PLI securities), management of debt, recoveries and the accrued interest and premium received on re-issues, plus the NSSF's interest to small savers (estimated); States = App. II interest less 'others' (intra-G_STA) and SDLs held by State governments. Every destination is in the satellite gov_interest_bridge.

sam_fincorp:9155a17f88a2.method: Constraint target for K2a E_RBI (fincorp-34 (a), audit BS-1): NAS 2026 St 1.9 public FC saving less St 7.1A financial OS and CFC (the D0-7 evidence of check k2a.rbi_cash_basis_evidence) less rest_of_world's R14 reserve-asset debit on E_RBI; band Rs 2,500 crore (the check's tolerance). Balancing then removes the unexplained BoP reserve income (D2-7) from E_RBI instead of saving it.

Public parts: E_BANK x (PSB + RRB operating profit) / (operating profit of SCBs, RRBs, UCBs, StCBs and DCCBs + the deposit-taking NBFC/HFC profit proxy), where the proxy = RTP NBFC-UL + NBFC-ML profit before tax x the deposit-taking NBFC share + RTP HFC (fund income + fee income - financial expenditure - operating expenditure) x the deposit-taking HFC share (the XR-6 boundary puts them in E_BANK; without the proxy the share is the plan's banks-only figure, kept in the satellite); co-operative banks and deposit-taking NBFCs are private (D2-14); E_INSP x (life GVA weight x LIC share of life operating expenses + non-life weight x public+specialised share of non-life net premium earned); E_NBFC public = NAS 7.1A financial OS + CFC less the other public parts (residual, AIFIs and government NBFCs). sam_government:82907c4254ec.method: Gap map K3a: government gross saving priors from a cash-to-NAS bridge (plan s.2.8 as repaired on 2026-10-01; latest vintages). Gross saving = GDI - GFCE, and CFC cancels (GG's GOS = CFC is income and CFC is inside GFCE), so no CFC is added to the cash balances (issues government-25, V-GOV-3). Centre = -(AFS 2023-24 revenue deficit) + net transfers to Public Account funds booked as revenue expenditure (all 2xxx/3xxx minor heads 797 + 'amount met from' fund deducts, Union FA) + grants for creation of capital assets (GCCA Statement 6, capital transfers) - T2b(ii) (paid from the GST fund outside the revenue account) - the net revenue of the departmental enterprises (Railways MH 1001-1003 receipts less MH 3001-3003 expenditure and MH 3006 appropriations from the Railway surplus to the Railways' own funds, Posts MH 1201 less MH 3201; public NFCs in NAS, so outside GG saving; their fund lines, including MH 3006's 797 line, are left out of the 797 / 'met from' sums). States = RBI SF App. IV A revenue balance - R2k IGAS-2 capital grants (booked as States' revenue receipts) + T2b(ii) + sinking-fund appropriation (App. II ii.c.1, internal to GG) + the revenue surplus of urban local bodies (inside G_STA, D2-8; FC16 cityfinance dump 2023-24, 4,620 ULBs: total revenues - total revenue expenditure - IGAS-2 capital grants to ULBs, which are capital transfers received from the Centre). The unexplained remainder (NAS 2026 St 1.9 GG saving - bridge) is allocated by the NVA (NAS 2026 St 4.1) of the GG units outside the Union and State treasury accounts, split as factors' F4b splits them (Centre: the autonomous institutions F4b gives the Centre; States: local bodies + the other autonomous institutions): their saving is what the treasury balances miss. Each government's saving is written as two entries in its cell, saving_pos (+) and saving_neg (-), with a margin equal to its share of the remainder (States: plus the ULB grants for the Centre's initiatives, whose capital part is unknown), so balancing can move the net across zero (XR-17, FRAMEWORK_REQUESTS P-9): low confidence.

sam_rest_of_world:0468ddf37b2a.method: Gap map R13, DECISIONS D2-7 (CROSS_REVIEW XR-4): RBI's income on foreign-currency reserves, as its Annual Report books it: Schedule 13(b) foreign-source interest sub-total + Schedule 14(b)(i) amortisation of premium/discount on foreign securities (rbi_banking_corporate_rbi_accounts, vintage 2025-05-29, 2023-24 column). Written on E_RBI <- R_ROW, anchored +-2% (RBI accounting vs BoP accrual).

sam_rest_of_world:08f4b07db5d0.method: Gap map K8b, NAS-BoP reconciliation (row_acquires): NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 17 net incurrence of foreign liabilities minus the sum of the BoP functional lines written for that side. Asset side: mostly the BPM6 vs old-format difference in 'other capital' (NAS other financial assets 98,339.48 vs old-format 98,450.04; EXT-13) plus whole-crore rounding; liability side: rounding. I_OTHR, fixed; no domestic counterpart (K9 absorbs it).

sam_rest_of_world:11be1c217a72.method: Gap map S3: RBI remittances survey 2023-24 round source-country shares (external_sector_remittance_survey remit.source_country.<iso3> and 'others', vintage 2025-03-19; bank channel), which sum to 99.80% as published and are normalised to 100, applied to the R11 total (NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 4). Estimated: bank-channel shares applied to all transfers. The 2016-17 and 2020-21 rounds are not used (territory scope ambiguous, external_sector-20).

sam_rest_of_world:1f577e10994c.method: Gap map K8b, India's net incurrence of liabilities (I_x <- K_ROW), one entry per BoP functional line, value as published (net flow), instrument and BoP functional tag as in plan s.2.6 (trade credit -> I_OTHR, plan s.5 item 15): bank_other_liabilities = BoP commercial banks' liabilities less NRI deposits. FDI/FPI instruments follow the BoP functional split, not the FSF (which puts all FDI and FPI in F51 nfc_pvt).

sam_rest_of_world:2f3bdfb7db3a.method: Gap map R14a: total = NAS 2026 St 1.9 memo 'reinvested earnings of foreign companies in private corporations' (mospi_nas_2026_s1_9). Payers: NFC vs FC by the FLA census 2023-24 round (vintage 2024-10-11), market-value equity at 2024-03-31: FC share = fla.t8.g.financial_and_insurance_activities.equity / fla.t8.total.equity = 16.0454% (face-value sensitivity fla.t2b.fc.fdi_equity / fla.t2b.total.fdi_equity logged). E_NFPU = 0: the NAS memo is 'private corporations' and the FSF has no public-NFC RoW counterparty. FC sub-split: E_BANK = foreign banks' profit (rbi_banking_corporate_rtp_banks rtp.scb_pl.income_total.fb - expenditure_total.fb, vintage 2025-12-29), divided reinvested : distributed in the national ratio (NAS reinvested earnings / BoP DI debit); the FC remainder goes to E_NBFC; E_INSP = 0 (no private-FC key is readable here: fincorp builds after this block; logged).

sam_rest_of_world:303358637ca8.method: Gap map R14: BoP oi primary-income debit by type (RBI HBS, BPM6), as published, as the total of the R14/R14a components ['ext_assistance_interest', 'nri_deposit_interest', 'oi_other_interest']; tolerance Rs 1 crore (whole-crore publication).

sam_rest_of_world:30cc61bc3261.method: Gap map R12: current transfers by resident sectors other than GG to RoW = NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 9 (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1 s6_1.other_current_transfers_by_resident_sectors_other_than_gener.current), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:32f73b3578db.method: Gap map K5: RoW saving = NAS 2026 St 1.9 net capital inflow from RoW (mospi_nas_2026_s1_9), as published; equal to minus NAS 6.1 surplus on current transactions (asserted to Rs 0.01 crore). NAS, not the BoP current account: NAS books government transfers with RoW (BoP 1.C.2) as capital transfers (external_sector-5).

sam_rest_of_world:37120e58dc35.method: BoP acceptance total (SPEC s.6(c)): NAS 2026 St 6.1 current disbursements (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1), as published: imports (production P6 + D2 CIF reconciliation) + CE to RoW (factors V4) + property income (R14, R14a) + current transfers (R12). Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:3b5179fe15ca.method: Gap map R14, portfolio income other than FPI interest on government paper: BoP 1.B.2.2 PI debit less the three fpi_*_interest components (FPI equity dividends plus interest on FPI-held corporate bonds and ADR/GDR). Payers: NFC vs FC by the FLA t8 equity key (external_sector_fla_census, vintage 2024-10-11); the FC part split E_BANK : E_NBFC in the ratio of their DI payments (R14 di_distributed + R14a). Low confidence (FPIs are heavier in listed financials than FDI is).

sam_rest_of_world:3d2c3a3d702b.method: Gap map R11: current transfers from RoW to resident sectors other than GG = NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 4 (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1 s6_1.other_current_transfers_to_resident_sectors_other_than_gener.current), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore (BoP rounding).

sam_rest_of_world:4027933c8729.method: Gap map R13, DECISIONS D2-7: BoP 1.B.2.4 reserve-asset income credit (bpm6.inr.bpm6_1_b_2_4.credit) less the RBI Annual Report figure (Sch 13(b) + Sch 14(b)(i)): the part of BoP reserve income the RBI accounts do not show (unexplained; candidates: accrual vs RBI accounting, income on gold, SDR interest that accrues to the Union, RTP). Assumption: the whole excess accrues to E_RBI, the holder of the reserves. Free, low confidence, so balancing may place it.

sam_rest_of_world:402f251416ca.method: Gap map R14: BoP di primary-income debit by type (RBI HBS, BPM6), as published, as the total of the R14/R14a components ['di_distributed', 'reinvested_earnings']; tolerance Rs 1 crore (whole-crore publication).

sam_rest_of_world:46590e3f1880.method: Gap map R11a. Total = NAS 2026 St 6.1 'other current transfers to resident sectors other than GG' (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1, latest vintage). Step 1: State/UT shares of inward remittances from the RBI remittances survey 2023-24 round (external_sector_remittance_survey remit.destination_state.*, vintage 2025-03-19; bank channel, 30 AD banks), normalised to 1. Step 2: within each State, shares of that State's HCES 2023-24 consumption falling in each national SAM group, from households' hh_state_xwalk (measure 'consumption', hces_class 'all', rural + urban; the national quintile placement of State fractile classes is households' estimate). R11a_g = total x sum_k s_k x w_kg. Assumptions (each stated here, low confidence): (a) the bank-channel State shares apply to all current transfers from abroad, including BoP 1.C.1.2 'other current transfers' (grants to NPISH, inside households) and non-bank channels; (b) within a State, receipts are proportional to consumption; (c) the survey's State is the State of the receiving bank branch (Maharashtra and Delhi may be inflated as banking hubs).

sam_rest_of_world:49788d426fcd.method: Gap map R14: BoP 1.B.2.4 reserve-assets income debit (content undocumented in the ingested tables; probably charges on SDR allocations, IIP SDR liabilities). Assumption: all of it is paid by E_RBI; it might belong to G_CEN. Low confidence.

sam_rest_of_world:56bdd768f55a.method: BoP acceptance total (SPEC s.6(c)): NAS 2026 St 6.1 current receipts (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1), as published: exports (production P5) + CE from RoW (factors V3) + property income (R13) + current transfers (R11; no R15, government books its RoW transfers as capital, K6). Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:5c13f4afd947.method: Gap map K8b, India's net incurrence of liabilities (I_x <- K_ROW), one entry per BoP functional line, value as published (net flow), instrument and BoP functional tag as in plan s.2.6 (trade credit -> I_OTHR, plan s.5 item 15): fdi_equity = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.fdi.in_india.equity.net.current; fdi_reinvested_earnings = NAS 2026 St 1.9 reinvested earnings (= Sum R14a; BoP 3.1.A.1.2 rounds it to whole crore); fdi_debt = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.fdi.in_india.other_capital.net.current; fpi_equity = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.portfolio.in_india.fiis.equity.net.current; ecb = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.loans.ecb.to_india.net.current; external_assistance = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.loans.external_assistance.to_india.net.current; short_term_trade_credit = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.loans.short_term.net.current; nri_deposits = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.banking_capital.commercial_banks.nri_deposits.net.current; rbi_deposits = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.banking_capital.others.net.current; rupee_debt_service = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.rupee_debt_service.net.current; errors_omissions = NAS 2026 St 6.1 other liabilities to non-residents (= BoP errors and omissions). FDI/FPI instruments follow the BoP functional split, not the FSF (which puts all FDI and FPI in F51 nfc_pvt).

sam_rest_of_world:5d05b87ba20f.method: Gap map R14a total: NAS 2026 St 1.9 memo, reinvested earnings of foreign companies in private corporations (mospi_nas_2026_s1_9), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:62b2f99a2bca.method: Gap map R14, NRI-deposit interest -> E_BANK: average NRI deposit stock at 2023-03-31 and 2024-03-31 (external_sector_nri_deposits nri.stock.inr.total, latest vintage) x SCB cost of deposits 2023-24 (rbi_banking_corporate_rtp_banks rtp.scb_cost_return.cost_of_deposits.scb, vintage 2025-12-29). Assumption: NRI deposits cost the all-SCB average rate (FCNR(B) pays less, NRE term more). Medium confidence.

sam_rest_of_world:719d2ff40e42.method: Gap map R13 total: NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 3, property and entrepreneurial income from RoW (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore (BoP rounding).

sam_rest_of_world:887d75fd1117.method: Gap map K8b, FPI debt split (the NSDL route is barred by its terms, finsector_markets-1, and the FSF books all FPI in F51 nfc_pvt): BoP old-format FII debt net inflow split into government paper (I_GSEC) = change in FPI holdings of central dated securities, T-bills and SDLs, each = HBS T107 FPI share x outstanding at 2024-03-31 minus the same at 2023-03-31 (rbi_financial_accounts_hbs_gsec_ownership, latest vintage; face value, not transaction value), and corporate debt (I_CBND) = the remainder. Two free entries, medium confidence, bound by constraint row.fpi_debt.

sam_rest_of_world:8a7ad1ea479b.method: Gap map R12a: NAS 2026 St 6.1 'other current transfers by resident sectors other than GG' (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1) allocated to urban quintiles 4 and 5 (H_U4, H_U5) only, in proportion to their consumption (households' hh_keys key 'pfce_total', measure 'level'). Deviation from the gap map's 'in proportion to income': group income exists only at closure, which this block cannot read; consumption is the stated proxy. Evidence that the channel is high-income: LRS gifts + maintenance of close relatives + donations = 67,913.30 crore (external_sector_lrs_outward), most of BoP 1.C.1.1 personal transfers debited. Assumption: all of BoP 1.C.1 debit (incl. 'other current transfers' and any corporate part) is paid by households, as the gap map says. Low confidence.

sam_rest_of_world:9a3e0cb6a858.method: Gap map R14: BoP 1.B.3 'other primary income' debit (content undocumented; question for RBI/NAD), plus the rounding gap NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 8 minus the sum of the five BoP primary-income types (+0.52 crore) so that R14 + R14a add up to NAS exactly. Assumption (key): pro rata to the other R14 components by payer (R14a excluded). Low confidence.

sam_rest_of_world:9b1eb47c2339.method: Gap map K8b total: NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 16 net acquisition of foreign financial assets (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:9efcf82531ea.method: Gap map R14: BoP pi primary-income debit by type (RBI HBS, BPM6), as published, as the total of the R14/R14a components ['fpi_gsec_interest', 'fpi_tbill_interest', 'fpi_sdl_interest', 'pi_other']; tolerance Rs 1 crore (whole-crore publication).

sam_rest_of_world:bf5615ffe488.method: Gap map R14: BoP reserves primary-income debit by type (RBI HBS, BPM6), as published, as the total of the R14/R14a components ['reserve_asset_debit']; tolerance Rs 1 crore (whole-crore publication).

sam_rest_of_world:c41752074f5a.method: Gap map K8b, NAS-BoP reconciliation (row_incurs): NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 16 net acquisition of foreign financial assets minus the sum of the BoP functional lines written for that side. Asset side: mostly the BPM6 vs old-format difference in 'other capital' (NAS other financial assets 98,339.48 vs old-format 98,450.04; EXT-13) plus whole-crore rounding; liability side: rounding. I_OTHR, fixed; no domestic counterpart (K9 absorbs it).

sam_rest_of_world:ceb0c27dffca.method: Gap map R14, direct-investment income distributed: BoP 1.B.2.1 DI income debit (bpm6.inr.bpm6_1_b_2_1.debit, includes reinvested earnings under BPM6) less NAS 1.9 reinvested earnings (written as R14a). Payers: NFC vs FC by the FLA census 2023-24 round (vintage 2024-10-11), market-value equity at 2024-03-31: FC share = fla.t8.g.financial_and_insurance_activities.equity / fla.t8.total.equity = 16.0454% (face-value sensitivity fla.t2b.fc.fdi_equity / fla.t2b.total.fdi_equity logged). E_NFPU = 0: the NAS memo is 'private corporations' and the FSF has no public-NFC RoW counterparty. FC sub-split: E_BANK = foreign banks' profit (rbi_banking_corporate_rtp_banks rtp.scb_pl.income_total.fb - expenditure_total.fb, vintage 2025-12-29), divided reinvested : distributed in the national ratio (NAS reinvested earnings / BoP DI debit); the FC remainder goes to E_NBFC; E_INSP = 0 (no private-FC key is readable here: fincorp builds after this block; logged). No FISIM adjustment on RoW property income (XR-13).

sam_rest_of_world:cedf519d1ca4.method: Gap map R13: BoP 1.B.2.3 other-investment income credit split over recipients by the FSF RoW-liability stocks of deposits (F22_F29) and loans (F4) by resident counterparty, average of 2023-03-31 and 2024-03-31 (rbi_financial_accounts_fsf_balance_sheets, vintage 2026-01-21); RBI (fc_rbi, reserves) excluded; fc_odc -> E_BANK, nfc_pvt -> E_NFPR, fc_ofc -> E_NBFC, gg_cen -> G_CEN. Deviation from the plan: debt securities (F3) are left out of the key, because income on debt securities is portfolio or direct-investment income in BPM6, not other investment, and the FSF F3 nfc_pvt stock mirrors its asset-side twin (plan s.6). Low.

sam_rest_of_world:d3b819b84d98.method: Gap map K8b total: NAS 2026 St 6.1 item 17 net incurrence of foreign liabilities (mospi_nas_2026_s6_1), as published; tolerance Rs 1 crore.

sam_rest_of_world:d9e25c17c5d3.method: Gap map R14, FPI interest on government paper, with fincorp's formula (CROSS_REVIEW XR-12): average of the FPI holding shares at 2023-03-31 and 2024-03-31 (rbi_financial_accounts_hbs_gsec_ownership HBS T107 t107.<instrument>.share.fpi, latest vintage) x the payer's interest line. Central dated securities: Union Finance Accounts 'interest on market loans' (union_fiscal_fa_expenditure fa9.2049.01.101) net of the accrued interest and premium received on re-issues (union_fiscal_fa_receipts fa8.0049.03.116 + .117; they arise on dated securities only, so each holder bears its pro-rata share). T-bills: fa9.2049.01.103 + .108 + .110 (the .103 line is treated as 91-day T-bills, as fincorp does). SDLs: RBI State Finances App. 2 'interest on market loans', all States/UTs (state_fiscal_rbi_sf_appendices). Estimated: shares are of face value outstanding.

sam_rest_of_world:d9f49a1ce5c1.method: Gap map R13 (fallback: the FLA census ODI sector split is not ingested). sam_rest_of_world:eb55f9f4cc2f.method: Gap map D2: NAS-BoP CIF reconciliation (CIF adjustment on imports of services), pinned, from the SUT 2023-24 Supply table memo row 'CIF' of the CIF-adjustment column (io_tables_sut_supply supply.cif_adj.cif.current), as published. sam_rest_of_world:ed4e78ea96ad.method: Gap map K8b, India's net acquisition of foreign assets (K_ROW <- I_x), one entry per BoP functional line, value as published (net flow), instrument and BoP functional tag as in plan s.2.6 (trade credit -> I_OTHR, plan s.5 item 15): odi_equity = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.fdi.abroad.equity.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); odi_reinvested_earnings = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.fdi.abroad.reinvested_earnings.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); odi_debt = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.fdi.abroad.other_capital.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); portfolio_abroad = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.portfolio.abroad.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); loans_by_india = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.loans.ecb.by_india.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); external_assistance_by_india = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.loans.external_assistance.by_india.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); banks_foreign_assets = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.banking_capital.commercial_banks.assets.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); other_capital = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.ka.other_capital.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition); reserve_assets = BoP (old format) bop_old.inr.monetary_movements.reserves.net.current with the sign reversed (asset acquisition). FDI/FPI instruments follow the BoP functional split, not the FSF (which puts all FDI and FPI in F51 nfc_pvt).

sam_rest_of_world:edf85a78854b.method: Gap map R14, other-investment interest other than external assistance and NRI deposits (ECB, trade-related and other loans, other deposits): BoP 1.B.2.3 OI debit less ext_assistance_interest and nri_deposit_interest, split by payer in proportion to the FSF RoW-asset stocks (India's liabilities) averaged over 2023-03-31 and 2024-03-31 (rbi_financial_accounts_fsf_balance_sheets, vintage 2026-01-21): loans F4 fc_odc -> E_BANK, fc_ofc -> E_NBFC, nfc_pvt -> E_NFPR; deposits F22_F29 fc_odc less the NRI deposit stock -> E_BANK, fc_rbi -> E_RBI. Left out: F4 gg_cen (its interest is ext_assistance_interest), F4 hh (tiny), trade credit F81 (mostly non-interest-bearing). No FISIM adjustment (XR-13). Low confidence.

sam_taxes:0ee0552babeb.method: Gap map T4a: corporation tax (MH 0020, RB cash) by paying sector. Corporate D5 prior = CIT + quasi-corporate MH 0021 (T3), split by old-base NAS 2022-23 D5 shares of public NFC, private NFC, public FC, private FC (oldbase_soa_s2_1/s2_2/s3_1/s3_2, NAS 2024 vintage); the quasi-corporate part is removed from the private sectors. FC sub-sectors bottom-up: E_INSP = IRDAI 2023-24 provisions for tax (life t24 + t25; non-life t51; public = LIC, public and specialised general insurers); E_NBFC = RBI RTP 2025-12-29 tax provisions of NBFC-UL, NBFC-ML, HFCs and AIFIs, less the deposit-taking share (FSF end-March 2024 assets, fc_odc_nbfc_dt / fc_odc_hfc_dt) moved to E_BANK (XR-6; assumed private); NBFC public part = AIFIs + old-base public share of FC D5 on the rest; E_BANK = FC total - E_INSP - E_NBFC (residual). Within E_BANK (plan s.2.7 step 4): the moved deposit-taking share is private; the rest is split by RBI RTP 2025-12-29 net profit 2023-24, public = PSBs + RRBs, private = PVBs + foreign + small finance + payments banks + local area banks (tax by bank group is not published; net profit assumes equal effective tax rates; public share 0.4165). E_RBI pays none (RBI Act s.48). Constraint bands t4a.fc and t4a.nfpu (public NFCs, audit BS-10): +-25% around the prior, a judgement tolerance with no source (t4a.nfpu copies t4a.fc's). The old-base series behind the shares (oldbase_soa_s2_1..s3_2, 2011-12 to 2022-23) puts 2022-23 at the lowest public NFC share of its 12 years, so the band is narrow on the upside; it can bind and then sets the level (close-out V-TX-6; Checkpoint B with taxes-27).

sam_taxes:41d5719ecee7.method: Gap map P10a (gross taxes): gross D29 = NAS 4.2 GG subsidies (D31 + D39) - NAS 1.1 product subsidies + P10 net (= 284,694.75). Identified heads: Union stamps (MH 0030 + UT MH 0710) and UT land revenue; States' stamps and registration fees, land revenue (RBI SF App I), property tax = urban immovable property tax (App I) + cityfinance ULB property tax (284 ULBs only); other_production_taxes = D29 residual. sam_taxes:4279ef5046b4.method: Gap map T3a: household income tax (Union: household share of MH 0021 + STT + MH 0028 + MH 0031/32) split over the 10 groups by a threshold-excess key: for each HCES 2023-24 fractile class f (A2, 2023-08/2024-07; class -> group from households' hh_group_map), income per household Y_f = 12 x MPCE_f x persons_f / households_f x k / (1 - s_g) (persons, households, MPCE as published in hh_group_map), k = NAS 1.1 PFCE / HCES aggregate = 2.2566, s_g = saving rate (IFPRI T11 national-quintile saving rates, person-weighted with households' hh_national_quintile_xwalk); key_g = Sum_f households_f x max(0, Y_f - Y*), Y* = Rs 700,000 per household (the 2023-24 new-regime rebate limit, Finance Act 2023: an assumption parameter). Uniform NAS scaling and fractile averages bias the key toward R5 and away from the very top.

sam_taxes:52b46ab9f531.method: Gap map P9a: SUT product subsidies (production's P9 entries) by paying government, commodity by commodity: C_CHEM, C_TREQ, C_RPET Union; C_UTIL, C_LVST, C_FOFI States; C_CROP Union = PM-AASHA (St 7), rest States; C_FINS Union = MISS (St 7), rest States; C_TRNS Union = air transport p137, rest States; C_TRAD States = FC16 21 States' food subsidies (XR-23, not grossed up), and the unexplained rest (C_TRAD remainder, C_OSRV, C_EDUC, C_HLTH, C_BSRE, C_COMM, C_CNST) at the identified Centre share 0.4600 (gap map Q7 rule).

sam_taxes:a0cc26519bc3.method: Gap map P7a: SUT 2023-24 product taxes by commodity (production's P7 targets, columns, exact) split into CGST, SGST, compensation cess, Union excise, State VAT, State excise and other product taxes. Rows = Union (Receipt Budget 2025-26 actuals) + State (RBI State Finances App I, all States + UTs) cash receipts by account (T_CGST = MH 0005 + MH 0008 + UTGST MH 0007; T_OPRT includes State + UT motor-vehicle tax (DECISIONS D2-4), electricity duty, goods and passengers, entertainment, other; Union MH 0044, MH 0045, export duty and CTT (D2-12)), scaled by one factor (SUT total / cash total) so the TAX-1 gap is spread pro rata (uniform scaling: an assumption), then a transportation-LP pre-check on the prior's pattern. Prior at SUT-product level: PPAC petroleum heads on p085 (excise, VAT, entry tax/octroi, GST = PPAC CGST and SGST/UTGST plus PPAC IGST split between the CGST and SGST priors in the ratio of their row targets; royalty and customs excluded; PPAC centre.a.others (51.50, unidentified) is not placed: the rows are cash, so it stays wherever it sits in them); PPAC cess + NCCD on crude on p043/p044 pro rata to their SUT tax (the SUT C_OILG tax equals it to the rupee); Union excise other than PPAC excise, cess and NCCD on p069 tobacco; State + UT excise on p065 up to its SUT tax, the excess as licence_fee_excess on p134 hotels and p132 trade pro rata to their SUT tax (gap-map fallback); electricity duty on p128; vehicle tax on p120/p121/p122 pro rata to PFCE + GFCF; goods and passengers on p136; entertainment on p155; MH 0045 on p149/p141 pro rata to imports; export duty on goods (SUT products p001-p126 that carry SUT product tax) pro rata to their exports; CTT on p142; non-petroleum VAT (State + UT sales tax less PPAC VAT on POL; component non_pol_vat, low confidence) pro rata to the room left on p065, p043, p085 (it lands on p085; on p085 beyond PPAC it is plan fallback (b)); MH 0044 + State other taxes less the PPAC entry tax/octroi pro rata to the GST residual (SUT tax less the loads above, GST products only: not p043, p044, p065, p085, p128); compensation cess = 0.5 x GST residual on p064, p066, p069, p120, the rest pro rata to the GST residual of the other GST products except coal p042; CGST : SGST = their row targets on the rest. Aggregated to commodities with io_tables_sut_product_to_sam34; RAS to the targets (1e-10). No GST-rate schedule is ingested, so the SUT's own residual (MoSPI's PFCE x item-rate allocation) is the GST shape.

sam_taxes:b0fd8c0a3601.method: Gap map P7b: each P7a item (pre-balancing; parent entry key in the row) spread over its commodity's uses (production's P2 IC by activity, P5 exports, I3 CII; C1/C2/I1/I2 targets for PFCE, GFCE, GFCF, valuables) pro rata to use value x eligibility: exports carry no GST, cess, excise or VAT (export duty only on exports); GST/cess on IC only for non-ITC activities (A_CROP, A_LVST, A_FOFI, A_UTIL, A_RPET, A_DWEL, A_EDUC, A_HLTH, A_PADM, A_OSRV; A_FINS/A_INSR 50%; A_BVTB at the alcohol share of its output), on GFCF only for C_CNST and C_TREQ, none on CII; electricity duty on IC + PFCE; vehicle tax on PFCE + GFCF; State excise on alcohol on PFCE + A_HOTL. Phase 4 applies the balanced z of the parent P7a entry (FRAMEWORK_REQUESTS P-10).

The difference from cash is the pro-rata share of the TAX-1 gap plus pre-check moves (a cash-accrual/coverage gap, not an accrual estimate). sam_taxes:e12ba5888e62.method: Gap map T1a: Union customs receipts (G_CEN <- T_CUST) = the sum of production's P8 entries (SUT import duty by commodity), pure aggregation; the cash figure less export duty is the T1 band.

sam_taxes:e2b1eea55e10.method: Gap map T3 extension (DECISIONS D2-11, D2-17): income tax paid by quasi-corporations = (1 - 0.785483) x MH 0021 (RB Sum of rb.tr.0021.*) + firm-only heads MH 0023/0024/0026. The household share = (old-base NAS 2022-23 household D5 (oldbase_soa_s5_0) - professions tax 2022-23 (FC16 State accounts MH 0028)) / MH 0021 2022-23 (old base, NAS 2024 vintage, 2022-23 FRE; cross-check IFPRI 2022-23 household taxes / MH 0021 = 0.9017). Co-operative banks' tax provisions (RBI RTP 2025-12-29, UCB) go to E_BANK (private, D2-14); the rest to E_NFPR.

sam_taxes:e35c12feed95.method: Gap map P10a (gross subsidies): gross D39 = NAS 4.2 GG subsidies - NAS 1.1 product subsidies (= 342,136.75); Union = St 7 interest subsidies less MISS and the LIC pension subsidy (government R18) + St 7 other subsidies less PM-AASHA + FC16 Union 'business' subsidies; States = the residual (low confidence). PM-KISAN (FA 2401.00.130) is not a D39 head (DECISIONS D2-24): NAS 4.2 does not itemise PM-KISAN, so its NAS treatment is inferred: St 4.2 current expenditure = consumption + subsidies + current transfers (subsidies and transfers are disjoint), and COFOG 04.agri current transfers are large enough to hold it, so it is taken to be outside the NAS subsidy total D39 is derived from; government writes it as R10 (government-30).

Ratio-linked at the 2022-23 overlap: not additive across flows; replace with MoSPI's new-base back series when published (ISSUES P1-6).

timeseries:ea18a384e772.method: Top-flows time series, flow F26 (Interest paid by the States), segment KF: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, kfi.b_1_a-interest_payments.in.all_states_28 from clean dataset state_fiscal_fc16_kfi. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). 28 States (FC16 key fiscal indicators).

timeseries:ea7dac287129.method: Top-flows time series, flow M03 (Exports of goods and services), variant linked_2022_23: for each old-base (2011-12) FY up to 2021-22, linked(t) = old(t) x new(2022-23) / old(2022-23) = old(t) x 1.004202039 (new-base NAS 2026 over old-base value in 2022-23); r(2023-24) = 1.002834516, within 0.02 of it; the flow keeps one sign. Ratio-linked at the 2022-23 overlap: not additive across flows; replace with MoSPI's new-base back series when published (ISSUES P1-6).

timeseries:eb2a782813fd.method: Top-flows time series, flow F01 (Private final consumption expenditure (PFCE)), segment NP: for each FY 2025-26..2025-26, api.pfce.rev_provisional_estimates.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_api_b2022_annual. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period).

timeseries:eee8fa10bd71.method: Top-flows time series, flow F37 (Household financial liabilities), segment NN: for each FY 2022-23..2024-25, s5_3.financial_liabilities.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_s5_3. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period).

timeseries:f233cb648937.method: Top-flows time series, flow F20 (Stamps and registration fees), segment KF: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, kfi.a_1_1_5-stamps_and_registration_fees.in.all_states_28 from clean dataset state_fiscal_fc16_kfi. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). 28 States.

timeseries:f2fe3010144f.method: Top-flows time series, flow M08 (Direct taxes on income (corporation tax + personal income tax incl. STT)), segment RB: for each FY 2022-23..2024-25, rb.tr.total.total_corporation_tax + rb.tr.0021.collections + rb.tr.0021.health_and_education_cess + rb.tr.0021.interest_recoveries + rb.tr.0021.miscellaneous_receipts + rb.tr.0021.penalties + rb.tr.0021.surcharge + rb.tr.0021.tax_under_black_money + rb.tr.0034.security_transaction_tax from clean dataset union_fiscal_rb_receipts. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). Union corporation tax + the seven MH 0021 lines + MH 0034 STT (as F21 + F22).

timeseries:f36434f7fa4d.method: Top-flows time series, flow F37 (Household financial liabilities), segment NO: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, oldbase_nas2025_s5_3.financial_liabilities.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_oldbase_nas2025_s5_3. timeseries:f94ee14e2a6c.method: Top-flows time series, flow M01 (GDP at market prices), segment NP: for each FY 2025-26..2025-26, api.gdp.rev_provisional_estimates.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_api_b2022_annual. timeseries:f96eb1281c29.method: Top-flows time series, flow F28 (Pensions paid by the States), segment KF: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, kfi.b_1_b-pension_and_other_retirement_benefits.in.all_states_28 from clean dataset state_fiscal_fc16_kfi. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). 28 States.

timeseries:fa0de1de7bef.method: Top-flows time series, flow F38 (Household physical saving (GCF excluding valuables)), segment NN: for each FY 2022-23..2024-25, s1_9.saving_in_physical_assets.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_s1_9. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period).

timeseries:fd105680b9f8.method: Top-flows time series, flow F36 (Household gross financial saving), segment NO: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, oldbase_nas2025_s5_3.gross_financial_saving.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_oldbase_nas2025_s5_3. timeseries:fea8ac5ba8e5.method: Top-flows time series, flow F18 (State sales tax / VAT), segment KF: for each FY 2011-12..2023-24, kfi.a_1_1_1-taxes_on_sales_trade_etc.in.all_states_28 from clean dataset state_fiscal_fc16_kfi. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). 28 States; concept break in 2017-18 (VAT subsumed into GST except petroleum and alcohol): flagged, not adjusted.

timeseries:fef3830e78af.method: Top-flows time series, flow M10 (Change in inventories), segment NB: for each FY 1950-51..2010-11, api.cis.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_api_b2011_back. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period).

timeseries:ff31e98bf876.method: Top-flows time series, flow F42 (Household borrowing from banks and co-operative banks), segment T12: for each FY 1983-84..2010-11, t12.liabilities.bank_advances.current from clean dataset rbi_financial_accounts_hbs_saving. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). T12 'bank advances' = NAS banks + co-operative loans.

timeseries:ffde8f38299f.method: Top-flows time series, flow F10 (Gross operating surplus and mixed income (incl. CFC)), segment NS: for each FY 2011-12..2022-23, oldbase_soa_s1_15.generation_of_income.uses.b2n_b3n.current + oldbase_soa_s1_15.production.uses.p51c.current from clean dataset mospi_nas_2026_oldbase_soa_s1_15. Rules: FY rows in INR crore at current prices; budget BE/RE rows excluded; the latest vintage per (series, period). net operating surplus / mixed income plus total-economy CFC (the old base publishes net only). Status derived by definition of the segment.
